name: codex-advisor
description: A second opinion from a configured native Codex subagent for consequential decisions and stalled work.

interface.shortDescription: A focused second opinion during difficult work
interface.longDescription: Consult a configured Codex subagent when a consequential choice is ambiguous, approaches repeatedly fail, or evidence conflicts. The main agent evaluates the advice and continues the original task.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-advisor for a second opinion on this decision.
